description: One malfunction report filed from the Rest app. The support team triages it here: status, priority, admin notes and the resolution date are the Desk's fields; the reporter, the page they were on and the optional private screenshot are what the app sent.

fields.description: The app's idempotency key for this submission. A replay with the same deployment and key returns this row instead of creating a second one.
fields.label: Client Request ID

fields.description: The Rest deployment that filed the report (its site name).
fields.label: Instance ID

fields.description: When the app recorded the report (the reporter's clock is not trusted; this is the instance's).
fields.label: Reported At

fields.description: Where the report came from. A future channel can record its own name without changing the doctype.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The signed-in user's Strapi document id. Stable across a rename, unlike the name or email.
fields.label: Reporter User ID

fields.description: The organization the reporter was working in, when their session named one.
fields.label: Organization ID

fields.description: What kind of problem the reporter chose. Set by the app and never edited here.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: The reporter's own words. Plain text, never rendered as HTML.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Optional screenshot from the app. Saved as a private file attached to this report.
fields.label: Screenshot

fields.description: The app route the reporter was on, path and query only — never a full URL with a session token.
fields.label: Page

fields.description: The browser's user-agent string. Diagnostic only; the support team reads it for a browser-specific fault.
fields.label: User Agent

fields.description: new: not looked at yet. in-review: being investigated. resolved: fixed. rejected: not a defect.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: What the support team found, and what the reporter was told.
fields.label: Admin Notes

fields.description: When the report was resolved or rejected.
fields.label: Resolution Date

name: Rest Malfunction Report
